name: biceps stretch behind the back
description: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
